workload.name: stock xv6-public forktest, 4 MiB, Bochs BIOS
workload.command: XV6_LEAN=1 XV6_FIRMWARE=bochs XV6_STEPS=40000000 XV6_STOP_ON_EXPECT=1 XV6_COMMAND=$'forktest\r' XV6_EXPECT_SERIAL=$'fork test OK\n$ ' node --import ./scripts/measure-i80386-hot-runs.mjs scripts/probe-xv6-stock.mjs
workload.comparison: Normalized full JSON report equals the preceding uninstrumented lean forktest after removing only absolute media paths.

method: Preload captures the first non-prefix opcode and first following byte during each original instruction, then counts successful retirements and maximal contiguous runs. Eligibility is opcode-family based and deliberately optimistic: it does not validate all operand forms, device access, faults, code-page boundaries, control-flow targets, page translations, or board chip-event exits. Strings are excluded from the noString variants because REP can retire many iterations at one EIP. Each completeN count is floor(runLength / N) * N summed over runs, before any real block exit constraints.
decision: The opcode mix justifies prototyping a broad memory/ALU/branch executor, but a 64-instruction straight-line batch is a poor primary design: even the optimistic wide non-string set has only 0.230% of all retired instructions in complete 64-instruction spans. Next build and measure short blocks with branch linking and a separate REP string path. These counts do not establish executable coverage, correctness, or a speedup.
